messages:
anya: Quick post-launch check — proposing a 'rampdown' prioritization for the next 2 sprints. Short doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/postlaunch-rampdown. TL;DR: bugs-first runway but with a fast-path for high-value customers. Thoughts?

sam: +1 to bugs-first for infra/user-impact P0s. Need firm definition of 'fast-path'.

michael: Customer side: ACME and Nova reported errors. They need comms + ETA. I can own customer-facing updates.

leah: From SRE: we can do canary+rollback within the release window, but we need an eviction/scale plan if canary triggers. Also want to cut alert noise.

anya: Proposal for bucketization: P0 = blocking (service down / major data loss) for paid customers; P1 = severe degradation; P2 = minor UX/regression. Fast-path = only P0s for top 3 customers (ACME, Nova, Finch). P1/P2 go into normal sprint queue.

sam: For rollout cadence I suggest: fix -> canary -> 24h canary evaluation -> global. Need a release window tomorrow 10-12 PDT. @release-bot can we reserve?

release-bot: release created: canary 2098765432-1 scheduled 2026-03-24T17:00Z. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/postlaunch-canary.

leah: I'll add rollback hooks and a feature-flag for fast disable. I'll also mute noisy alerts for the canary channel.

michael: I'll draft customer note: short summary + ETA + who to contact. Will ping you for wording, @anya.

anya: Decision for now: two-sprint bug-first runway starting tomorrow. Owners: sam -> infra fixes, leah -> rollout/ops, michael -> customer comms. Tracking label: "rw-postlaunch-fastpath" on GH issues.

sam: I'll open the GH issues and Jira cards and tag owners. Acceptance criteria suggestion: error rate < 1% or p99 latency < 300ms for 24h after global.

leah: Slightly conservative: p99 < 350ms first sprint given load. We'll tighten in sprint 2.

anya: OK — weekly sync M/W 10:00am. P0 huddle ad-hoc whenever needed. Add agenda: telemetry thresholds, rollback cost estimate, and per-customer SLAs.

michael: I'll message ACME/Nova/Finch after canary green. Also prepping a brief status page update.

sam: Posting a PR for changelog + release notes now. Assigning reviewers.

anya: If no objections by EOD we'll lock sprint plan and update roadmap doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/roadmap#postlaunch-rampdown. :thumbsup:

leah: :thumbsup:

michael: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:
